name: Khan Bahadur Khan Rohilla
contribution: Khan Bahadur Khan Rohilla led the rebel administration and resistance in Bareilly during the 1857 uprising against East India Company rule.
context: North and central India during the anti-colonial uprising of 1857-1859.
impact: His leadership shows how regional elites used the rebellion to challenge Company authority and restore local political power in Rohilkhand.
highlight: Leader of the Bareilly uprising in Rohilkhand during 1857.
seoTitle: Khan Bahadur Khan Rohilla: Bareilly Leader of 1857
seoDescription: Learn about Khan Bahadur Khan Rohilla and the rebel administration he led in Bareilly during the 1857 uprising.
shortAnswer: Khan Bahadur Khan Rohilla was a regional leader of the Bareilly uprising against Company rule in 1857.
